tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by three different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
New York has passed a law restricting minors from using artificial intelligence chatbots as friends or romantic partners, citing teen mental health concerns. Confirmed by TechJuice.
Adversa AI launches a real-time security platform blocking attacks on artificial intelligence agents in under 0.2 milliseconds. Confirmed per PR Newswire.
Google's Gemini 4 Carbon excels in secure code generation and vulnerability patching, with 10x better performance than frontier models. Reported by SC Media.
Mistral releases open weights for its 1 trillion-parameter ML4 model, trained on 3,800 GPUs, with sharp coding and cyber defence gains. Reported by The Next Web.
Wall Street firms update ratings and targets post-earnings for 15 or more companies including Nvidia, Anthropic, Apple, Tesla, Chevron, Microsoft and Alphabet. Confirmed by CNBC.
Free every hour.
